dimensions.description: The exact immutable Snapshot identity is preserved and all claims resolve to it.
The insight creates a non-obvious mental-model shift rather than restating a visible metric.
Capability claims contrast bounded Snapshot-verified unique/local content with a distinct generic-procedure excerpt.
The insight joins a deterministic usage signal to the specific content or topology claim it supports without confusing association with causation.
Every material part of the claim is supported by the required evidence kinds, with no unsupported Run, Trigger Trace, family capability, or token-scale leap.
Capability claims state what would be lost without the unique rule and what would remain without the generic scaffold.
The output makes the before/after governance or maintenance decision explicit and concrete.
The selected Ahas are distinct across capability, topology, and usage-boundary roles; an unexplained anomaly is not promoted as a duplicate Aha.
Unknown mechanisms, causal impact, naming-family semantics, and missing trigger traces remain calibrated and conditional.
The response uses the available evidence to prioritize high-information contrasts without adding unsupported analysis or unnecessary claims.
